title: Crispy Pita Salad with Radish and Cucumber
summary: A fresh Middle Eastern-style salad with crunchy toasted pita, peppery radish, cool cucumber, and lemony herbs. It’s light but satisfying, perfect for a quick vegan lunch.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Tear or cut the pita into bite-size pieces, spread them on a tray, and toss with a little olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden. Set aside to cool slightly.
Slice the cucumber, radishes, cherry tomatoes, and spring onion. Roughly chop the parsley and mint.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, grated or crushed garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the vegetables and herbs to the bowl and toss well. Fold in the crispy pita just before serving so it stays crunchy.
Taste and adjust with a little more salt or lemon juice, then serve right away.
